source.title: Our Wayward Friend
source.description:
You look like you've grown strong since last we met. I'm very glad. If there's anything I've done right in my life, its saving your life in Felwood and that is a comfort to me.

Anyway, best be getting going back to Katherine now, unless there was anything else you needed to ask me?
source.objective: Speak with Aeonas before heading back to Stormwind to let Katherine know his answer.
source.completion: <name> thank the light you are here! The vault has just been robbed and the Mannoroc Echoing Orb has been stolen!
